title: Health Investment, Environment, and Population Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2503.00391v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this working paper, I developed a suite of macroeconomic models that shed light on the intricate relationship between economic development, health, and fertility. These innovative models conceptualize health as an intermediate good, paving the way for new interpretations of dynamic socio-economic phenomena, particularly the non-monotonic effects of health on economic and population growth. The evolving dynamic interactions among economic growth, population, and health during the early stages of human development have been well interpreted in this research.

translated_title: 健康投资、环境与人口动态
translated_abstract: 在本工作论文中，我开发了一套宏观经济模型，以阐明经济发展、健康和生育率之间的复杂关系。这些创新模型将健康视为一种中间产品，为动态社会经济现象的新解释铺平了道路，特别是健康对经济增长和人口增长的非单调效应。本研究很好地解释了人类发展早期阶段经济增长、人口与健康之间不断演变的动态相互作用。
tldr: 本文通过将健康视为中间产品的宏观经济模型，揭示了健康对经济与人口增长的非单调影响，并阐释了早期人类发展中三者间的动态关系。
en_tdlr: This paper develops macroeconomic models treating health as an intermediate good, revealing non-monotonic effects of health on economic and population growth and interpreting dynamic interactions in early human development.
